title: The backup restore was never tested
summary: The nightly backups run, but nobody restored one. The plan proposes one restore test each month.

badges.tip: A script checked the backup job log.

blocks.title: What we found
blocks.html: The backup job ran on 30 of the last 30 nights. [TESTED] The log has no restore [src: ../report.md].

blocks.title: Proposed action
blocks.html: Restore the newest backup into a test server on the first Monday of each month. Record the time that the restore takes.
